# Parley v0.1.11

This beta is a packaging hotfix for the Ghostty runtime resources introduced
in the recent native terminal releases.

## Fixed

- Parley no longer relies on an absolute SwiftPM build-machine path when
  Ghostty initializes.
- The packaged application now resolves Ghostty's library data, terminfo,
  themes and shell integration from the signed macOS application resources
  directory.
- Release packaging fails closed if SwiftPM changes the generated Ghostty
  resource accessor instead of silently producing a machine-dependent app.
- The package contract verifies that the Ghostty resource bundle is present in
  `Parley.app/Contents/Resources` before signing or creating release archives.

This fixes the immediate startup crash reported when the v0.1.10 application
was copied to another Apple Silicon Mac without the original Swift build tree.

## Upgrade notes

- Quit Parley before replacing the existing application. Quitting ends its
  live pane processes and app-resident coordination core.
- Workspace definitions and local collaboration history remain compatible.
- Agent protocol v9 is unchanged, so existing v9 panes do not require a
  protocol restart.

## Install and trust

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- At least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.11-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in
  Applications, and reopen it normally from Finder.
- This beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. Use **System Settings >
  Privacy & Security > Open Anyway** only when the files came from this expected
  release. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

Use `Parley-0.1.11-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
